post.description: Conversation items require a trusted product caller or authorized teacher reviewer. Rejection is local, preserves snapshots/images and does not invoke upload return workflows; optional returnReason is a local review explanation (maximum 2000 characters). Omitted rootCause preserves the conversation teacher analysis. Existing upload and extraction review rules remain unchanged.

analysisSnapshot.description: Item-owned worksheet analysis, returned only by GET /api/mistakes/{id} for pending or confirmed worksheet mistakes with a saved snapshot. sourceVersion is the revision used for these fields, not the current job version. Independent of rootCause.

ProblemDetails.description: Framework binding ProblemDetails when configured; empty/non-JSON is also allowed by the response content alternatives.

versionChange.reason: Emenda runs only as a standalone product. The platform modes, platform JWT authorization, Student integration, managed source intake/targets/returns/handoffs/layout jobs, the legacy upload and manual-add intake, the obsolete complete-review step and the VL structured analysis/reanalysis were removed. Mistakes enter through the AI Tutor extraction intake (emenda-extraction-v1) or conversation collection.
